pages.title: A Catch Can Do More
pages.text: Turn fishing-derived equipment into useful movement or control.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: The watch respects forbidden targets. The Dragonfin Boots extra jump does not count for this goal. A Jelly Torch can be placed underwater for light.

pages.title: Use fishing-derived equipment
pages.text: Dragonfin Boots give an extra jump restored on landing, but it does not count for this goal. Freeze an eligible creature with the Enchanted Pocket Watch to complete the goal. Jelly Torches work underwater.
